title: Bolts

# Bolts

# Introduction

Bolts are a type of ammunition for Crossbows.
Bolts' damage is added to base crossbow damage before any other damage calculation. (See Damage mechanics for details).

### List of bolts

• Name: Bone bolt | Damage: Pierce: 32 | Knockback: 0

• Name: Iron bolt | Damage: Pierce: 42 | Knockback: 0

• Name: Black metal bolt | Damage: Pierce: 62 | Knockback: 0

• Name: Carapace bolt | Damage: Pierce: 72 | Knockback: 0

• Name: Charred bolt | Damage: Pierce: 82 | Knockback: 0

Categorias: Weapons, Bolts
